title: Complete idempotent operation results, pending-intent recovery and typed errors

checkpoint.summary: Added explicit read-only reconciliation of local pending requests against one verified remote ledger snapshot, with full action payload and ledger identity matching. Added explicit hash-gated, idempotent acknowledgment that removes local evidence only when verified. Ambiguous task/review/integration write results now recheck the canonical operation index and recover accepted matching writes, otherwise preserve OutcomeUnknown, UUID and last confirmed head. Eight independent Git clients concurrently retained every receipt without modifying source HEAD/index.
checkpoint.nextAction: Complete domain-specific version/checkpoint/phase result projections and originating commit evidence; verify recovery against remote outages, rewritten refs, and full 8-attempt contention bounds. Then re-audit V2-02 for closure.

Read-only reconciliation distinguishes applied, absent, mismatched payload, mismatched ledger identity; local journal unchanged until explicit hash-matched acknowledgment
Lost remote response is recovered only when exact canonical operation matches; otherwise OutcomeUnknown retains caller UUID, verified head and pending intent
